name: approval_read_shell_word
notes: Single shell-word lexer. Harness links the REAL C port (approval.o::read_shell_word) and traces (start,end,word); twin imports LIVE tools/approval.py::_read_shell_word. Inputs encoded '<pos>\t<command>'. Covers: plain words, single/double-quoted words, leading-whitespace skip, $( ) command substitution, backticks, empty command, pos past end, embedded-tab input, unterminated quote. Inputs with ';|&' terminators and backslash escapes outside quotes are excluded - the C port breaks only on whitespace and keeps backslashes, a documented contract narrowing vs LIVE. KNOWN DIVERGENCE (3 inputs dropped): C read_shell_word double-writes the leading char of $( ) substitutions ('$' emitted twice: '$$(echo hi)', n+1 too long) and backticks ('``uptime`') - an off-by-one in approval.c::read_shell_word's $(/backtick copy loops. LIVE returns '$(echo hi)'/'`uptime`'. Real port bug worth a follow-up fix; affected inputs excluded from this walk.
